sources.title: Jundot/clef-flash-oQ4e · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: clef-flash-oQ4e This model was quantized using oQ mixed-precision quantization. A mixed-precision MLX checkpoint of Cloudflare/clef-flash, a decision model that answers typed questions (noul, choice, score) about text and images with a probability for each option. sources.title: Releases · jundot/omlx - GitHub
sources.snippet: Clef and Clef-Flash (27B, 9B, text and images) and OpenJev (27B, text and one image) are detected automatically, or you can set the model type to decision. oQ keeps Clef's joint head intact, and ready-made Jundot/clef-oQ4e and Jundot/clef-flash-oQ4e checkpoints are available. #4315 decision1.mp4 Batched Prefill for Concurrent Requests

sources.title: deepseek-v4.1-flash Model by Deepseek-ai | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek-AI that accepts text and images, generates text autoregressively, supports a combined context of up to one million tokens, and provides continuously controllable reasoning effort.
